paper.title_en: Analytic Metric for Rotating Black Holes in Higher-Derivative Gravity
paper.abstract_en: We turn metric reconstruction into an analytic solver for rotating black holes in modified gravity, bypassing the direct solution of coupled field equations. As an example, in parity-even cubic gravity, we construct the first analytic spinning black hole metric at linear order in the coupling, without spin or weak-field expansions. We stringently validate the field equations and reproduce independent analytic predictions for horizon properties. This establishes a new route to construct spinning black holes beyond Einstein gravity and lays the foundation for strong-field tests.
